title: Seamless Gutter Installation - Hampton Cove
description: Complete seamless gutter system for a two-story home with complex roofline.
details: This Hampton Cove homeowner needed a complete gutter replacement. The original builder-grade gutters were failing at the seams after just 8 years. We installed 6-inch seamless aluminum gutters in bronze to complement the home's exterior.

title: Gutter Guards Installation - Madison
description: Heavy-duty leaf guards installed on existing gutters surrounded by mature oaks.
details: Located in a heavily wooded Madison subdivision, this homeowner was cleaning gutters 4-5 times per year. We installed micro-mesh gutter guards that handle both large oak leaves and small pine needles.

title: Underground Drain System - Huntsville
description: Complete underground drainage solution for water pooling issues near foundation.
details: This Huntsville home had serious water pooling near the foundation due to North Alabama's notorious red clay soil. We installed 4-inch corrugated drain pipe with pop-up emitters positioned 30 feet from the house.

title: Rotten Fascia Repair - Decatur
description: Extensive fascia board replacement and aluminum capping to prevent future rot.
details: Years of Alabama humidity and overflowing gutters had caused significant fascia damage. We replaced 45 feet of rotten fascia board with treated lumber and installed aluminum fascia capping for long-term protection.

title: Complete Gutter System - Athens
description: New construction gutter installation with underground drainage.
details: This new-build Athens home needed a complete gutter system. We installed 6-inch seamless gutters with leaf guards and ran underground drains to a drainage easement at the back of the property.
